overview: Eigenvalue lambda wo scalar hai jiske liye Av = lambda v (v != 0). GATE me: eigenvalues nikaalna (characteristic polynomial), trace/determinant se shortcut, matrix functions (A^2, A+kI, A^-1) ke eigenvalues, aur special matrices (symmetric, projection, triangular) ki properties.
whyItMatters: 33 PYQs, 1993-2026; 2014 se almost har saal 1-2 sawal (NAT + MCQ).
coreConcept: det(A - lambda I) = 0 characteristic equation hai; uske roots eigenvalues hain. Sum of eigenvalues = trace, product = determinant.
hinglishExplanation: Eigenvector wo direction hai jo matrix lagne par sirf stretch/shrink hoti hai (ghumti nahi). Poori 2x2 ya 3x3 ka polynomial banane ke bajay pehle trace aur determinant shortcut socho: agar ek eigenvalue diya ho to baaki trace/det se mil jaate hain. Triangular/diagonal matrix me eigenvalues = diagonal entries.
formalDefinition: det(A - lambda I) = 0; A v = lambda v.
importantProperties: Sum of eigenvalues = trace(A); product of eigenvalues = det(A).
Triangular/diagonal matrix ke eigenvalues = diagonal entries.
A^k ke eigenvalues lambda^k; A + cI ke lambda + c; cA ke c*lambda; A^-1 ke 1/lambda (lambda != 0).
A aur A^T ke eigenvalues same.
Symmetric real matrix: eigenvalues real; alag eigenvalues ke eigenvectors orthogonal (dot product 0).
Idempotent/projection matrix (A^2 = A): eigenvalues sirf 0 aur 1.
Rank-1 matrix uu^T: ek non-zero eigenvalue = u^T u, baaki 0.
Cayley-Hamilton: matrix apni characteristic equation satisfy karta hai.
Adjacency matrix of graph symmetric hoti hai, eigenvalues ka sum 0 (trace 0).
commonPitfalls: A^-1 ke eigenvalue lena par 0 eigenvalue ke case me invertible hi nahi hota.
Eigenvalues ka product determinant se sign galat.
Eigenvector ko normalise karna bhoolna jab unit vector maanga ho.
standardTechniques: 3x3 me trace + det + ek known eigenvalue.
Function of matrix: eigenvalues par function lagao.
